entities.summary: Li Nan is a former professional basketball player from China. Before his retirement in 2009, he played for the Bayi Rockets, a Chinese Basketball Association team based in Ningbo, Zhejiang. As a small forward, he is 1.98 m tall and weighs 104 kg (229 lb). Li Nan was a athletes & competitors from Harbin (b. 1976-09-25, Harbin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
